newsitem.title: UK: BA says April passenger traffic up 6.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: BA says April passenger traffic up 6.9 pct.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Tuesday tha paying passenger traffic in April rose 6.9 percent, while capacity rose 5.5 percent, to give an overall load factor of 71.6 percent -- up 0.9 percentage points on a year ago.

The airline said lucrative premium business and first class traffic was up 11.1 percent last month on a year ago, compared with 6.1 percent growth in other ticket sales, and cargo traffic was up 8.2 percent on a year ago at 328 million tonne-kilometres. The airline said passenger traffic was up in spite of the disruption of London Gatwick on two days last month caused by the suspected Irish Republican Army campaign of bomb threats against England's road, rail and air transport networks.
BA said traffic comparisons with a year ago were also distorted by the fact that the busy Easter holiday period fell in March this year and in April last year.
